DESCRIPTION.general: Required dictionary. Retained general configuration; its scan_timeout setting is not consumed by the Network workflows.
DESCRIPTION.general.scan_timeout: Legacy configuration value currently unused by Network operations. TCP scans use port_scan.timeout; this setting does not control WiFi scans.
DESCRIPTION.port_scan.ports: Required list of TCP ports to scan. Results contain open ports only, sorted numerically with duplicates removed. Ports need not have metadata.
DESCRIPTION.port_scan.timeout: Required number of seconds passed to each TCP connection attempt. A positive value is recommended; configuration validation checks the type, not the range.
DESCRIPTION.port_scan.workers: Required integer controlling concurrent connection attempts. The scanner clamps values below 1 to 1.
DESCRIPTION.port_scan.port_info: Required dictionary, possibly empty, keyed by ASCII numeric TCP port strings in 1-65535. Entries require string service and note fields. Unlisted ports display empty metadata.
DESCRIPTION.port_scan: Required dictionary containing ports, timeout, workers and port_info.
DESCRIPTION.port_scan.port_info.<PORT>.service: Required string in each metadata entry. Service label displayed for an open port; may be empty.
DESCRIPTION.port_scan.port_info.<PORT>.note: Required string in each metadata entry. Risk note displayed for an open port; may be empty.
